LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 1.3.1 WORD CLASSES: DEMONSTRATIVE DETERMINERS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Demonstrative Determiners
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Demonstrative Determiners, part of Strand 1 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: How do you identify objects that are near or far? 2. How do we show that objects being referred to are singular or more?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. recognise signs of vocabulary related to the theme,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Demonstrative Determiners in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Demonstrative Determiners together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: team work as the learner work in groups and pairs to identify demonstrative determiners in a variety of texts.

• Digital Literacy: interacting with digital technology as the learner manipulates digital devices as they search for more examples of sentences

containing demonstrative determiners in print and digital texts.

Values:
Unity: Cooperation is developed as children work accomplish tasks in groups

Link to other Subjects:

The learner relates the knowledge gained in learning demonstrative determiners in learning Kiswahili
